competitors.name: PIANO PIANO
competitors.action: PIANO PIANO announced a coast-to-coast Canadian rollout for its 72-hour naturally leavened sourdough frozen pizzas through Walmart Canada, Country Grocer, and Coleman's, taking the line to more than 350 retail locations and reinforcing that restaurant-origin premium frozen pizza can scale nationally.

competitors.name: C&S Wholesale Grocers / Sol Select
competitors.action: C&S launched Sol Select, a new 250-plus-SKU private label line that explicitly includes frozen pizza and will expand this summer into D&W Fresh Market, Family Fare, Martin's Super Markets, and SpartanNash independent partners, a useful signal that value-tier private label frozen pizza distribution is widening through wholesale-led networks.

competitors.name: Clean Eatz Kitchen
competitors.action: Clean Eatz Kitchen added three classic cauliflower-crust frozen pizza flavors, Cheese, Hawaiian, and Pepperoni, to a new QVC drop with nationwide frozen shipping, showing continued demand for health-positioned frozen pizza sold through direct and TV-commerce channels rather than traditional grocery alone.

trends.topic: The frozen pizza aisle is fragmenting into premium restaurant-origin sourdough at the top, health-forward DTC formats in the middle, and widening private-label value distribution underneath.
trends.magnitude: Three separate channel signals in one week: national premium retail rollout, wholesale private-label expansion, and national QVC frozen shipping.
trends.context: Real Dough should stay clearly premium and story-led, because the category is getting more crowded at both the value end and the wellness end.

market_data.value: 6-count frozen pizza pack for $59.98 with nationwide shipping

breaking.headline: Fresh signal: frozen pizza growth is spreading across three lanes at once, premium sourdough retail, value private label, and health-forward direct commerce.
breaking.impact: Real Dough should not drift toward the middle. The strongest move is to sharpen its restaurant-grade sourdough proof, premium ingredient story, and shelf distinction while monitoring how quickly private label and wellness brands crowd adjacent price bands.
